task:
FINDER F4b, PART 1a OF 3: THE EXPLORE SURFACE (PICKER, RANKED CARDS, PAGING, MAP POINTS) AND ITS UNIT AND COMPONENT TESTS, ON THIS BRANCH.

AUTHORITY: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f4-archetype-ui-design.md. Read section 8 "PR F4b — visible slice-1 picker and ranked cards" (its file list and the paragraphs after it), and the sections it relies on: section 5 (Picker; Result row/card anatomy; Tier semantics and colours; Honest uncertainty; Loading, empty and error states; Keyboard and screen readers; Inspect, map and later weight pop-out), section 6 (State and URL contract), section 7 (Unit tests (Vitest); Svelte component tests), and section 9 "Owner answers (2026-10-21)", where the Question 1 bullet "amended 2026-10-31 (owner)" governs the fit label. Where the design's review-round entries and its main sections differ, the main sections and the owner answers govern.

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS: F4a (#870) is on main. Reuse apps/web/src/lib/features/explore/archetypes.ts (keys, display names, tiers, evidence badge), ranking-state.ts (URL codec, request selection, page-size and window rules), apps/web/src/lib/config.ts (the default-off VITE_FINDER_F4_ENABLED gate) and the facade in apps/web/src/lib/api/client.ts. Do not duplicate them. This branch also carries the API change that adds rival_archetype and rival_score to selected-archetype ranking rows; the facade's ExploreSystem already carries both as optional fields.

PART 1a SCOPE, from the F4b list: create ArchetypePicker.svelte and ArchetypePicker.test.ts; create FinderResultRanking.svelte and FinderResultRanking.test.ts (including the below-cap, exact-10,000 and sentinel-overflow Any count copy); ranking-state.ts and ranking-state.test.ts (last-valid-page normalization; positive out-of-range and genuine-zero cases); ExploreWorkspace.svelte, ExploreWorkspace.test.ts and ExploreWorkspaceTestHost.svelte (one envelope owns page_size, offset, list and map; three one-row pages; stale-offset replacement and refetch; the separate draft and committed anchor; the Clear anchor control; result and Babylon picks write selected=<id64> without opening detail; the deduplicated selected point kept and reconstructed with the existing getSystem path); compare-metrics.ts, compare-metrics.test.ts, ComparePanel.svelte and ComparePanel.test.ts (suppress distance from the Compare table and CSV in the F4 surface until F4c); apps/web/src/lib/spatial/explore-scene.ts and explore-scene.test.ts, and apps/web/src/lib/spatial/babylon/adapter.test.ts; apps/web/src/app.css (the five semantic tier tokens of section 5). All paths are under apps/web/src/lib/features/explore/ unless given in full.

THE SHARED NAVIGATION HELPER: the design routes every /explore navigation that must keep the anchor through one anchor-state-preserving helper, goto(destination, { replaceState: true, state: page.state }) or its push form, never the native History API. No such helper exists yet. Create it in this part, in one module that ExploreWorkspace uses now and that SystemOverlay, the Inspect page and WatchlistPanel will import in part 1b. If no listed file fits, a new small module is acceptable; name it in your final answer.

FIT LABEL (owner decision 2026-10-31; section 9 Question 1 as amended): shown only in selected-archetype mode, that is rows from /api/archetypes/rankings when the committed URL carries archetype=. Compare the row's selected-fit integer score (the picked archetype's own 0-100 score shown in card item 3) with its rival_score. Clear fit when the score is at least 3 points above rival_score; otherwise Close fit, and the Close fit text names the rival's display name and score, for example "Close fit · Megacomplex 79". It is its own element beside item 4's Primary/Secondary line, never inside item 3's fit score or item 5's evidence badge, and its visible text is its accessible text. When rival_archetype, rival_score or the score is absent or null, render no label. Any mode never renders "Clear fit", "Close fit" or the word "fit" in visible or accessible text. Put the rule in one pure helper in archetypes.ts, with the 3-point cut-off as one named constant, and test it in archetypes.test.ts: gaps of 3, 2, 0 and a negative gap, an unknown rival key, and absent fields. These two files are a 2026-10-31 addition to the F4b list, because the amendment postdates it.

GATE: everything new stays behind the existing default-off VITE_FINDER_F4_ENABLED gate. With the gate off, F4a's disabled-build behaviour and its tests must still pass unchanged.

LEAVE FOR LATER PARTS, do not edit them in this run: apps/web/src/lib/api/client.ts and client.test.ts, WatchlistPanel, AppShell, SystemOverlay, apps/web/src/routes/inspect/ (part 1b); apps/web/Dockerfile, .github/workflows/, apps/web/cypress/, apps/api/, scripts/, tests/ (Python), CHANGES.md and docs/ (part 2). Do not change API code or generated clients.

CHECKS TO RUN in apps/web with Node 24 and pnpm 11.25.0: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm check, pnpm lint, pnpm format:check, pnpm test, pnpm build. Do not run Cypress.

FINAL ANSWER: list every changed file with one line each; name the navigation helper's module and its exported functions; list every place where you had to interpret the design, with the section you relied on; and give the check results with test counts.
